262a) Consecration with the vase; [offering of] sandalwood and so forth; and so on; together with the garments; the self-consecration; the benediction.
The bliss of all; the full moon; the dismissal of Kaumārī.
"O you who are the most auspicious among all that is auspicious," and so forth; [this is] for the purpose of bearing witness.
The ritual procedure for the fire-sacrifice of the illustrious Caṇḍikā is complete. May there be auspiciousness at all times!
